Drag Church returns April 4th with REBIRTH! 

Transformation doesn’t always arrive gently.
Sometimes it arrives as unraveling.
As the necessary crumbling of what can no longer hold us.

Drag Church: REBIRTH is rooted in the understanding that new beginnings require release. Release of old stories, structures, and ways of being that no longer serve us. 

REBIRTH invites participants into a shared moment of detachment and possibility. Through drag art, reflective meditation, and communal participation, we explore the truth that transformation often feels like breaking at first.  And that breaking is not failure, but foundation.

This is a night about letting go together. About trusting the collapse. About choosing to build something new in its place.

Come help us build the next generation of collective liberation with joy and queer imagination on April 4, 2026 at 7400 Woodlawn AVE! Tickets released on February 1st. Follow @yassifyjesus and @hausofsutra for updates! 

Production @yassifyjesus & @hausofsutra 
Performers @bjblessings @thebrandi_marx @jizzuhbelljohnson @kara.sutra @sid_seedy
